propositions: Merge-abort recovery logic is duplicated across sync.reconverge and push_recovery, with a third caller in doctor.py, and the two implementations have already drifted in handling (sync and doctor lack the tracked-path fence that push_recovery applies).

The quarantine mover and merge-abort parser must be extracted into a single neutral owner (merge_recovery.py) that accepts git as a callable parameter to accommodate both sync's module-level _git and push_recovery's late-bound core._git seam.
Both sync.py and push_recovery.py must retain thin delegating adapters with their original signatures to avoid breaking monkeypatches and direct imports in test suites and callers like doctor.py.

The consolidated quarantine_untracked mover must verify tracked paths are not moved by checking git status --porcelain before any filesystem operation, enforcing the stricter invariant across all three call sites.

A construct-uniqueness guard using AST scanning must enforce that exactly one quarantine mover (shutil.move/copy2 + quarantine identifier) exists outside merge_recovery.py, with a mandatory escape reason marker.
